propositions: code-review gate declares per-step model classes on five LLM-calling steps in YAML; all five declarations are silently ignored at runtime and every step runs on cfg.model instead
PydanticAIRunner.run discards req.config.model and resolves the model only from its constructor-time self._config, rendering per-step model routing inert downstream of RunnerAgentStep

Step 0: usage_log.record must capture step id and declared model class token on every LLM call so per-step attribution is observable and future diagnostics are deterministic rather than inference-based

the fix: _effective_config substitutes req.config.model into runner cfg when they differ, honouring the per-step declaration while preserving the floor config for all model-adjacent downstream (ProviderSession, capabilities, cache_settings_for, base_url)
